Lech am Arlberg

High, snow-sure and quiet: Lech, Zürs, Zug and Oberlech on the Arlberg.

Plan a trip to Lech am Arlberg

In short

Lech am Arlberg at a glance.

Lech is a village in Vorarlberg on the Arlberg. It is part of Ski Arlberg, one of the largest connected ski areas in Austria, with Zürs, St. Anton and Warth-Schröcken on the same lift pass.

Region
Vorarlberg, Austria
Ski area
Ski Arlberg: Lech, Zürs, Zug, Oberlech, St. Anton, Stuben, Warth-Schröcken
Nearest airports
Innsbruck (about 1.5 hours), Zurich (about 2.5 hours)
Best for
Ski weeks with excellent food and hotels; off-piste with a guide

Who Lech am Arlberg is for

Skiers who want big terrain without big crowds, and families who want to ski from a small village.

When to go to Lech am Arlberg

Winter for skiing, usually from early December to late April. Summer for hiking in the Lech valley.

How to get to Lech am Arlberg

Innsbruck Airport is about an hour and a half away by car; Zurich about two and a half hours. By train to Langen am Arlberg or St. Anton, then a short transfer.
